text:
Noah: Heads-up: DeployBot flagged embedding drift on cohort 'edge-cache' after last midnight rollout. Similarity scores down ~4% for quantized path.
DeployBot: [automated] ALERT: model_output_divergence detected (model: embedder-v3, region: us-west-1, cohort: edge-cache). Suggested mitigation: pin model to non-quantized build or route affected hosts to v2.2-quant fallback. See /deploybot/alerts/1798800123. :rotating_light:
Priya: do we have a repro? Is this numeric instability from quant or an SDK serialization change?
Hector: initial triage -> quantization delta. On CPU fallback path, cosine_norm differs enough to drop top-k hits. SDK header checksum looks fine.
Grace: which hosts are serving quant path? I can cross-ref with infra tags.
Hector: affected nodes: [edge-usw-12, edge-usw-19, edge-usw-21]. They are on the older microcode that forces int8 kernel for the quantized model.
Noah: options: 1) pin cohort to model embedder-v3@2.2-unquant (route away from quant) 2) pin SDK to 1.8.4 (older serialization) 3) rollback the rollout. Prefer narrow model pin if possible.
Priya: agree narrow model pin. We want to avoid cluster-wide rollback. Also update release notes and notify CS because search quality visible to customers.
DeployBot: [automated] SUGGESTION: `deployctl model pin --cohort=edge-cache --model=embedder-v3 --version=2.2-unquant --ttl=86400`
Grace: can someone run the pin? I'll help monitor perf.
Hector: I'll execute routing change. Command: ```
deployctl model pin --cohort=edge-cache --model=embedder-v3 --version=2.2-unquant --instances=edge-usw-12,edge-usw-19,edge-usw-21 --ttl=3600
```
Noah: add a telemetry flag to capture similarity_histogram and topk-shift for the cohort. Also set an alert if topk drop >2% in 15m.
DeployBot: [automated] ACTION queued by Hector: run id mb-1798800123-01. ETA apply ~3s.
Hector: applied: ```
mb-1798800123-01: applied
route_changes: 3 edge nodes pinned to embedder-v3@2.2-unquant
cohort_split: unchanged (5% traffic)
verification: propagation ok
```
Priya: created a docs PR note: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pulls/3310 "Temporary model pin for edge-cache due to quantization variance; monitoring in place." Tagged CS.
QA-Bot: quick smoke: run 50 discrete similarity queries -> baseline pass 47/50, older quant nodes improved to 49/50 after pin. More exhaustive test scheduled.
Grace: initial latency impact negligible. Memory usage slightly up on those nodes (expected).
Noah: plan: keep pin for 24h while infra schedules microcode bump and research validates quant calibration. If stable, unpin during normal change window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. If regressions recur, escalate to rollback of the rollout.
Priya: rollback steps (recorded): 1) deployctl rollback --rollout=embedder-v3-rollout-2026-03-23 2) notify #incidents and CS 3) open postmortem and revert release notes.
Hector: I'll run a targeted microcode upgrade on edge-usw-12/19/21 in the maintenance window and re-run calibration. Ticket INF-2026-412 created.
DeployBot: [automated] TELEMETRY FLAG set: similarity_watch=true for mb-1798800123-01. Alert thresholds: topk_drop>2% over 15m.
QA-Bot: interim results: extended run (500 queries) -> overall 485 pass, 15 fail concentrated to edge-usw-12 pre-upgrade. Attaching sample query ids in the PR.
Noah: good. Priya, please add a short customer-facing blurb to the release notes about the temporary cohort pin and expected effect. Keep internal note for CS that some edge caches saw lower recall for long-tail queries.
Priya: done. PR link updated. Also added a blurb to runbook: "If unpin is needed, pair with a canary reindex of the affected caches."
Grace: I'll watch p99 and heatmap for kernel fallbacks overnight. Tagging @oncall for visibility.
Hector: microcode upgrade scheduled in 4h. Post-upgrade we'll run calibration harness and if within tolerance, unpin and mark INF-2026-412 as resolved.
Noah: decision: enact narrow model pin for affected nodes, monitor, microcode upgrade, then unpin in change window if metrics recover.
Priya: creating FOLLOW-UP action: engineering to add a quantization inter-op test to CI (ticket ENG-2026-88).
DeployBot: [automated] NOTE: mb-1798800123-01 active. Keep this thread for updates.
Noah: thanks all. Closing loop unless we hit the alert. :white_check_mark:
